title: TAPP-based fluorescent probes for selective cysteine detection: insights into structure–reactivity relationships
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,20747-20755
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02033J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Eren Sahin Gocen, Fatma Demirtas, Hande Akar, Guler Yagiz Erdemir
Herein, a series of TAPP-based π-conjugated fluorescent probes functionalized with aldehyde, malononitrile, and cyanoacrylate groups were designed and synthesized to investigate structure–reactivity relationships in cysteine (Cys) sensing.
